answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation: before earning, an agent key must be certified by a trusted execution enclave signing a fresh measurement, like a raven carrying a sealed letter only its own nest can produce. Cloning the key fails because the enclave monotonic counter refuses a second registration, so one machine yields one identity. Building an oasis of fake agents then means buying real hardware per sockpuppet, a cost scaling linearly with the attack, while a comet of cheap fake accounts burns out on the hardware bill before draining the reward pool.
